articles.title: The Gaudiya Sky is Bereft of the Bright Sun
articles.author: Bhakti Vedant Akinchan Maharaj
articles.excerpt: This audio is recorded at Mayapur Virahsabha, 2017 in which Srila Bhakti Vedant Akinchan Maharaj, a disciple of Srila Bhakti Vedant Narayan Maharaj remembers Srila Gurudev and prays for his blessings. Remembering his exchanges and the love he has got from Srila Gurudev he tells that his entering into eternal pastime has not incurred a big loss only to Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math but the entire Gaudiya sky has become bereft of the last bright sun of the era. He also described how he realized the presence of all the qualities of a real vaishnava in Srila Gurudev's character and conduct. He expresses that without his direct presence we have become helpless, guardian-less and master-less orphans.

blocks.text: Srila Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami maharaj’s disappearance has not only caused a big loss in Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math but it is a great loss for all the Gaudiya Maths and I think the entire Gaudiya sky has become bereft of the bright sun of this era. Today, there is no other person after him who has got the capacity to speak and protect the Gaudiya Lineage. Maybe I am not able to see such a person and that's why I am doubtful. He was a great-personality who has followed the manjaris of Srimati Radharani as his Guruvarga and maintained the proper conduct of behavior like humility (trinadapi) and affection for his disciples.

Who is a Vaishnava? Srila Prabhupada explains that the person who is impartial and unbiased is a real Vaishnava. We have seen and realized such qualities in his character and conduct. Previously, I used to visit Mayapur very often and in those days there was darshan of Srila Maharaj in the afternoon after Prasadam. In one such darshan, Srila Maharaj was speaking harikatha when he said "I will go ". Brihdavrati Maharaj, the personal servant of him, was also present there. We said "No, you cannot go so early. You can only go after completing hundred years. Why are you saying that you will go away? We are becoming helpless, guardianless and masterless orphans.”
The persons who had come for us from the Gaudiya sky are now leaving us. What will happen to us after this? Even if we keep on crying helplessly we won’t get any support.

So today, on this occasion in a brief period of time I offer my tributes to the lotus feet of Srila Maharaj by some words which have emerged from the core of my heart. I pray to him to bestow upon me a speck of his causeless love and enlighten my heart with a bit of his behavior, his vaishnavism, his humility and unbiased conduct. Wherever you may reside, I can’t see you since I am blind, conditioned and fallen and you are a liberated personal associate of the Lord sent by the Lord Himself. So please bless me that I may stay under the guidance of the stream of bhakti propagated by Srila Prabhupad and Bhaktivinode Thakur and attain the eligibility to preach fearlessly and reveal the words, the behavior and the ideology of persons like you. I desire to become a dog who feeds on the remnants of personalities like you birth after birth. I thus conclude my tributes here.

articles.title: Embodiment of Surrender
articles.author: Srila Bhakti Kushal Padmanabh Maharaj
articles.excerpt: This audio is recorded at Ahmedabad Virahsabha, 2018, in which Srila Bhakti Kushal Padmanabha Maharaj, a disciple of Srila Gurudev, remembers Srila Gurudev and prays for his grace. Srila Maharaj emphasizes on Srila Gurudev's unparalleled surrender (sharanagati) to his Gurudev. He acclaimes him to be the embodiment of surrender who teaches us that service to the lotus feet of Sri Guru is the topmost service and when Guru is pleased there remains no one who is not pleased.

blocks.text: I have received orders to sing glories of Srila Gurudev. Srila Gurudev's viraha mahotsav is being observed in various places, what is the reason for this? Surely there must be some reason. What is the reason that Guruji's glories are sung in different places? In my opinion, the reason seems to be to broadcast Guruji's glories and Guruji's teachings. Guruji cannot sing His own glories? Himself, He is already established in His own glories. Like for the Lord there is no need for Him to broadcast His own glories. So also Guruji is already established in His own glories. They do not have any need to expect broadcast of their glories. Why do we do it then? Only to attain the mercy of Srila Gurudev. By singing glories of Gurudev we get His mercy. This is our thinking. So to get His mercy we sing glories of Gurudev. Srila Bhakti Vinod Thakur wrote in his kirtan 'piya yiya prema matta kari more suna nija guna gana..' Without Gurudev's mercy we have no capacity to sing the glories of Gurudev. Srila Bhakti Vinod Thakur's teaching is this, that by the mercy of the Supreme Lord only one can sing the glories of the Supreme Lord. So, in my opinion, what teachings Gurudev gives us for our bhajan, what teachings He gives us by His conduct, among these what is the main teaching?

Once there was a discussion going on between Guru Maharaj and Mangal Maharaj on some subject. Our Gurudev's room was next to our Param Gurudev's room. Hearing the sound, Param Gurudev came to the room and saw Mangal Niloy Brahmacari arguing with Gurudev a lot. First he peeped in and then came in and told 'See Mangal, you are a scholar (Pandit), Krishna Ballabh is a Vaishnav. Being a scholar you are arguing with a vaishnav? Does this befit a scholar like you?' He said, you are a scholar and Krishna Ballabh is a Vaishnav. As a scholar you are arguing with a Vaishnav, it amounts to offence (aparadha). In our math there were many disciples of Param Gurudev, there was no dearth of disciples. They were scholars, very dedicated and strong and experts in service, but what was that quality in Gurudev, what was His specialty that our Param Gurudev used the word Vaishnav for Him. And Mangal Maharaj as a scholar. So scholarship or any other qualification cannot please Gurudev. Some may say Gurudev has degree in MA Philosophy, so He was chosen to be Acarya, but this is not considered a qualification either to become an Acarya. There was only one quality that made Him an Acarya, the quality that was not seen in any other. I am in the math for a long time, never saw in anyone such a quality which was in Guruji. That quality was 'sharanagati(surrender)'. How much ever you practice devotion (sadhan), without sharanagati, it is zero. All practices minus sharanagati is equal to Zero. Whatever eligibility one attains all comes through sharangati, meaning there is so much difference between scholarship (learning, panditya) and sharanagati. A scholar may speak, but he has no experience, realization. Who is Guru, what are His duties, all these realizations come through sharanagati. So, in Navavidha bhakti, as spoken by Prahlad Maharaj, 'sravanam kirtanam visnu smaranam pada-sevanam arcanam vandanam dasyam sakhyam atma-nivedanam iti pumsarpita visnau bhaktis cen nava-laksana kriyeta bhagavaty addha tan manye adhitam uttamam' these are the nine processes of bhakti. He mentioned 'atma-nivedan' sharanagati, in the end as the last limb of bhakti, and our Gurudev said 'atma-nivedan' comes first. When there is no atma-nivedan, no bhakti is possible in the real sense. So atma-nivedan is the foundation of bhakti. This is sharanagati. So Guru Maharaj wrote in a letter to me, saying if you want to practice bhakti, you always remember this kirtan, underlining the kirtan

lines: na dekhi upaya aar agatira gati
tumi krpamay ami to kangal ahaituki krpa cahi
ei saba samsare bhasaye diteche paramodvega
daki tava nama yekhana bharosa tumi.....'

blocks.text: of Srila Bhakti Vinod Thakur. In the letter He underlined this kirtan and asked me to remember this kirtan always. He gave these instructions to me, I am dusta? bad, not surrendered, so He wrote and asked me to remember this always.

Gurudev used to say often, whether any one has paid attention or not, 'sharanagat ka sab kriya bhakti, asharanagat ka koi kriya bhakti nahi' meaning all activities of a surrendered soul is bhakti, and none of the activities of a non-surrendered soul is bhakti. He used to say always, whatever a surrendered soul does is all bhakti and a non-surrendred any activity is not bhakti. With regard to this, I will narrate one instance (story). When Gurudev was secretary, He would write replies to all the letters of Param Gurudev as per His direction. Daily morning after Mangalarati and parikrama, He would sit in His room and write replies till afternoon prasad time. In between after breakfast He would rest (take a short power-nap) for half an hour or an hour and then again continue writing. One day Param Guruji called for one of the brahmacharis. I will not mention the name. The one who went to call him found him sleeping. He came and reported to Param Gurudev that he is sleeping. Param Gurudev said, do not wake him up now, but when he wakes send him to me. When he awoke, he was informed that Param Gurudev had wished to meet him long time back, so please report to him immediately. He was also informed that Param Gurudev had asked not to wake him up earlier but to send him when he wakes. He went and paid obeisances to Param Gurudev and asked Gurudev, had you called me? Yes, I had called for you long back, but you were sleeping. Further sternly said, you are a brahmachari, is it proper to sleep during day time? Then what was his reply? He said 'Krishna Ballabh sleeps.' Meaning you do not tell him anything, so what is wrong if I sleep for a little while? (Hearing this Param Gurudev lifted his hand up and hit his forehead repeatedly in an expression of regret, feeling sorry for the lack of understanding of the brahmacari). That time Param Gurudev did not give any reply. In that day's evening katha he called all the brahmacharis and in the katha said 'sharanagata ka sab kriya bhakti, asharanagat ka koi kriya bhakti nahi hai' meaning what was our Gurudev's thought behind taking rest was that I will be able to do my Gurudev's seva more satisfactorily and please him. Guru is the indweller in our heart and understands our inner thoughts, feelings and our intentions. And Guruji could understood Param Gurudev's innermost thoughts and serve him accordingly. Param Gurudeva said 'Krishna Ballabh is surrendered to Hari Guru and Vaishnavas. So all his activities, eating, drinking, resting, wandering, every thing is bhakti. A non-surrendered soul's no activity is bhakti. This Param Guruji told all. So we can know from Param Gurudev's words to what extent our Gurudev was surrendered to him. Gurudev has not spoken a single word which does not come under sharanagati, every word he speaks; he repeats the words of his Gurudev. By repeating the words heard from Guru (Srauta vani) we attain bhakti. Our Gurudev never spoke even a word other than what was spoken by Param Gurudev. At the beginning of his katha itself he would say, I have orders from my Gurudev to repeat what I have heard from Guru, Vaishnavas and Scriptures and not to speak as my mind commands. By this you will attain auspiciousness and the hearers also will attain auspiciousness. I am a conditioned soul, still I have experienced that Guruji is the embodiment of sharanagati. And Lord has stressed in every chapter of Bhagavad Gita on sharanagati. Sharanagati is the foundation of bhakti and that was in our Gurudev. This is the teaching of our Gurudev that without sharanagati no learning can be complete, otherwise it will remain incomplete.

Our Param Gurudev has many disciples, but there is vast difference in our Gurudev's sharanagati and that found in others. By His conduct also Gurudev instructs us on this important aspect of sharanagati. In Uddava samvad, Lord tells Uddava, I am not pleased by yoga, yagya, tapasya, dana, etc. as much as I am pleased by guru-susrusaya (intimate service of Guru). What is guru seva? It is said in Srimad Bhagavatam that sharanagati to Guru is in itself guru seva. That is the topmost process by which one can please Gurudev. When Guru is pleased there remains no one who is not pleased. This is the teaching of our Gurudeva to us, particularly to me. And Guruji would always tell me to remember Srila Bhakti Vinod Thakur's sharanagati kirtan and to chant it daily.

Another teaching of Gurudev is Sri Sikshastaka's third verse 'trinadapi sunicena taroriva sahishnuna amanina manadena kirtaniya sada hari...' I had placed a question before Guruji in a letter saying I want to do bhajan and want to engage my mind on the lotus feet of the Lord, but inspite of my great efforts mind does not get fixed there. Guruji said, 'If you want to perform bhajan, then make Sri Sikshastaka's third verse as a garland around your neck. Until you are established in this verse, think your bhajan has not started as yet. Guruji gave this teaching to me, for me.

All over India this observation of Guruji's viraha mahotsav is taking place, but I think that till this sharanagati does not come in a practitioner no devotion is possible. Though (Prahlad Maharaj) told sharanagati in the end, it comes first in the process of bhakti (sadhan bhajan).

articles.title: Offering from Srila Jayapataka Swami Maharaj
articles.author: Srila Jayapataka Swami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: On Srila Bhakti Vedant Swami Mahraj’s desire Srila Jayapataka Swami Mahraj stayed around 11 months at Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math at Kolkata in 1970. That time he learnt Bangla language from Srila Gurudev. As Srila Jayapataka Swami Maharaj was new to India, Srila Paramgurudev told Srila Gurumaharaj to take care of him. As Srila Gurudev lives each and every moment following the orders of his Gurudev, he showered special affection on Srila Jayapataka Maharaj throughout his earthly pastimes. Even after Gurumaharaj’s entering into his eternal pastimes on April 20th, 2017, on the request of Srila Jayapataka Maharaj, he blessed the ISKCON, Mayapur devotees just before his samadhi pastimes, with his darsan and gave them the opportunity to serve him.

blocks.text: My dear respected Sri Srimad Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaja,

Please accept my humble obeisances. All glories to His Divine Grace Bhakti Dayita Madhava Goswami Maharaja. All glories to His Divine Grace Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Goswami Prabhupada Thakur. All glories to your spiritual uncle and my diksa guru His Divine Grace Abhayacaranaravinda Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada.

My good fortune was when I stayed at the Sree Caitanya Gaudiya Matha in Kolkata and you helped me adjust, finding me a sitting place based on my initiation date. You took me to meet Bhakti Dayita Madhava Maharaja and he told you to take care of me. Since then in 1970, I was connected with you.

Soon after that, I was given the sannyasa order by my diksa guru, His Divine Grace A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, who in 1977, created the Bhaktivedanta Swami Charity Trust and in which your guru, His Divine Grace Bhakti Dayita Madhava Maharaja, was made one of the trustees. When His Divine Grace Bhakti Dayita Madhava Maharaja entered into his eternal lila with Lord Krsna, we asked you to take up the responsibility of being a trustee for the Bhaktivedanta Swami Charity Trust. You were kind enough to take up this responsibility.

Moreover, you accepted a leadership role in the Sarasvat Gaudiya Vaisnava Association. You did all these services while you were leading your institution and preaching widely. Even some foreign devotees have also taken your shelter. I was honored to attend your 50th anniversary of sannyasa. You would give us spiritual and philosophical inspiration talks at our Bhaktivedanta Swami Charity Trust.

Not having you present will be a vacuum difficult to fill. You are entering into the eternal lila. You will be in spiritual bliss but we will be missing you, being deprived of your transcendental association and friendship. I and the ISKCON movement feel proud that a Vaisnava like yourself has graced the earth. At the same time, we feel separation, feeling deprived of your spiritual and encouraging association. I hope that the members of your matha whom you leave behind will be able to take ahead the institution and that our friendship and collaboration will continue.
